target.title: policy: repair channel ingress findings
target.body:
## Summary

- Add the channel ingress automatic repair slice after merged #99700.
- Repair `policy/ingress-open-groups-denied` by setting the exact reported `groupPolicy` path to `allowlist`.
- Repair `policy/ingress-group-mention-required` by setting the exact reported `requireMention` path to `true`.
- Keep the existing `workspaceRepairs=true` opt-in and skip scoped findings that inherit shared `channels.defaults.*` config.

## Validation

Pre-restack validation on the same five-file policy diff:
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/cli.test.ts src/commands/doctor-lint.test.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts --reporter=dot` passed: 3 shards / 350 tests.
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.extensions.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions.tsbuildinfo` passed.
- `OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/policy/src/cli.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/scopes/channels.ts src/commands/doctor-lint.test.ts src/commands/doctor-lint.ts` passed.
- `node --import tsx scripts/check-policy-config-coverage.ts --check --json` passed with no unclassified, unmatched, or stale monitored paths.
- `git diff --check` passed.

Post-#99700-merge restack validation:
- Replayed the two commits onto current `upstream/main` without conflicts.
- `git diff --stat upstream/main...HEAD` shows the same five-file policy diff: 324 insertions / 1 deletion.
- `git diff --check` passed.

## Stack

- #99700 has merged.
- Current head: `6814e1ff`.
- Keep draft until ClawSweeper has reviewed the refreshed head/proof and CI is clean.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior or issue addressed:
`doctor --fix` repairs policy channel ingress narrowing findings by updating only the reported OpenClaw config path for `groupPolicy` or `requireMention`, while skipping scoped inherited `channels.defaults.*` findings that would mutate shared defaults.

Real environment tested:
Windows PowerShell source checkout. The behavior was tested through the real policy doctor registration and repair flow in source harness tests; no packaged OpenClaw binary, live provider, or LLM call was started.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/cli.test.ts src/commands/doctor-lint.test.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts --reporter=dot`
2. `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.extensions.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions.tsbuildinfo`
3. `OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/policy/src/cli.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/scopes/channels.ts src/commands/doctor-lint.test.ts src/commands/doctor-lint.ts`
4. `node --import tsx scripts/check-policy-config-coverage.ts --check --json`
5. `git diff --check`

Evidence after fix:
Focused Vitest passed 3 shards / 350 tests, including policy doctor repair coverage for automatic channel ingress narrowing findings and scoped inherited ingress skips. Extension tsgo, targeted oxlint, policy config coverage, and `git diff --check` all exited 0. After #99700 merged, the same two commits replayed cleanly onto current `main`; the resulting PR diff is five policy files, 324 insertions / 1 deletion, with `git diff --check` still clean.

Observed result after fix:
Channel ingress repairs now set only exact emitted config paths for eligible findings, preserve workspace repair opt-in gating, and leave inherited shared channel defaults unchanged for scoped policy findings.

What was not tested:
No packaged CLI smoke, live provider run, live channel delivery, or live LLM call was run for this source-harness proof.
